metadata.world_axes: X forward, Y left, Z up

configuration.name: Part023 vertical forward limit with extended rear stance
configuration.contact_model: Discrete rolling on evaluated convex sole: retain a material vertex during contact; transfer at supporting-feature changes. Ground is research world Z=0.
configuration.angle_bounds_note: Part023 O-D must stay at or behind vertical in side view. Alpha lower bound -34.24 degrees is derived from measured neutral O-D angle 124.249 degrees. Other combined-pose bounds remain provisional and are not calibrated hardware limits.
configuration.blocking_geometry: Previously identified mount interference retained in the current model; this gait edit does not modify geometry or establish physical efficiency.
configuration.shoulder_strategy: Whole-body lateral sway and wider stance solved through the shoulder axis with world-fixed rolling stance contacts.
configuration.maximum_claim_scope: Whole-body research candidate; no global stride or energy optimum claimed.
configuration.body_motion_model: Periodic smooth lateral and fore-aft translation and body height; fixed orientation. All 12 angles solved together with passive four-bar closure.
configuration.timing_model: One-second posture transition, four 0.8-second setup steps, 4-second velocity ramp, 1 settling cycle(s), three repeated 4-second cycles, 4-second deceleration, four return steps, one-second stand transition.
configuration.user_visual_review: Accepted as close enough on 2026-09-15. This records visual gait acceptance only, not physical walking validation.
